# Introduction

#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## Introduction

In a map, elements are stored as a key/value pair.

- keys - unique identifiers that are associated with each value on a map
- values - actual data that can be accessed using keys

![Map as a Key-Value Pair](data:image/png;base64,)

Next, we will learn how we can create maps in C++.
